record.question: Choose the correct homophone to fill in the blank: Ask him __________ he is ready to go or not.
record.explanation: Answer A: whether. “Whether … or not” introduces the two alternatives about readiness. Wither and weather are different words. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
